summary: UMB Financial Corp filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing a $0.43 quarterly common dividend and a Series B preferred dividend of $193.75 per share ($0.484375 per depositary share). The board also authorized repurchase of up to two million common shares through the board meeting following the 2027 annual meeting. No price, premium, or advisor details are provided. These capital return actions are routine shareholder distributions. What to watch: actual share repurchase pace and any future capital management updates.
